description: A type for dicts with fixed string keys (PEP 589). Calling the class builds a plain `dict`; nothing is validated at runtime.
Per-key overrides of `total` (PEP 655), reflected in `__required_keys__` and `__optional_keys__`.
Marks a key that must not be assigned after creation (PEP 705, Python 3.13); listed in `__readonly_keys__`, enforced only by checkers.
A type whose values are exactly the listed constants (PEP 586); `get_args` returns them.
Split a parameterized annotation: `get_origin(list[str])` is `list`, `get_args(list[str])` is `(str,)`.
